title: Codefall consult answer
description: One agent's answer to one question a run could not settle on its own (ADR-009). The agent proposes; the session that asked decides. An answer with cannotSettle true, or confidence low, advances the walk to the next agent in the order.

answer.description: The option taken or the course proposed, in one or two sentences. Empty when cannotSettle is true.

confidence.description: high: the files settle it. medium: a judgment the agent would defend. low: a guess; the session treats it as no answer.

reasoning.description: Why, citing files and lines where they decided it, and what each option seen would cost.

cannotSettle.description: True when the question needs something the agent does not have: a person's preference, a fact outside the repository, or a choice that is hard to reverse and belongs to a human.

reversible.description: Whether the proposed answer could be undone later without other work being redone. Absent when cannotSettle is true.
